_diag_log_enabled_doc: MASTER switch for the diagnostic log file. Default false: the app never creates a log file (privacy-by-default release posture). Set true (and restart) to write logs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Emebalachat\logs\ for debugging; the whole logs folder is capped at 200MB (oldest files pruned at startup). Only enable while actively troubleshooting.
_diag_log_content_doc: Only has an effect when diag_log_enabled is true. Logs are shape-only by default (key codes, window class, lengths, timings). Set true to ALSO record user content: typed characters, foreground window titles, captured text and translation output. Privacy decision: only enable while actively troubleshooting, and restart the app after changing this value.
_hotkeys_doc: hotkey_toggle/lang/mode accept 'Mod+Key' (Ctrl/Shift/Alt/Win + F1-F24, Enter, Esc, Tab, Space, arrows, A-Z, 0-9). Invalid values fall back to defaults. drag_hotkey supports only 'double_ctrl_c'. Overlapping combos fire one action in order: toggle > lang > mode.
